tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: code blocks, input fields, footers.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Noir is the brand's home ground; Paper is for print, invoices and long reading.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, menus, case-study panels on surface-100.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between sections. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons) and the edge of anything clickable; at least 3:1 on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, timestamps on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The signature accent — the () in the logo. Fills for the primary action, highlights, one key word. Never more than one amber thing per view.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an amber fill.

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Amber used as text or a link on surface-100 and surface-200 (Paper darkens it to stay legible).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with a word, never color alone. Text on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations (sent, paid, deployed), always with a word. Kept blue, off the red–green axis.

styles.name: logotype
styles.usage: Only for setting the name live where an SVG can't go (the cover, a site header). Matches the logo files exactly: Martian Mono 800 at -0.04em, the () in amber.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: hero statements, cover slides.

styles.name: display-accent
styles.usage: The one emphasised word or phrase inside a display-xl or headline line: Gloock roman, then Schibsted italic. Gloock has no italic, so never fake one.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I design brands and build the software they live in.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every project starts with a conversation, not a template.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Overlines, section numbers, tags, metadata. Lowercase, often ending in ().

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control: icon to label, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Section spacing on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop. Be generous: black needs room to look expensive.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Photos, sections, cards and buttons are square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags and code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Only the a() app mark tile (40 on a 240 tile, about 1/6 of its side).
